name: Magic Shoppe
desc1: It is immediately obvious what this dwelling is as soon as you walk
desc2: in. The room is nearly filled with arcane items and talismans of all
desc3: sorts, and such esoteric things as Griffin claws and vials of Dragon's
desc4: blood. As you turn your eyes towards the back of the room, you see a
desc5: bored-looking young man sitting behind a counter. A large rack of
desc6: rolled parchment scrolls sits behind his head. A shimmering bead
desc7: curtain blocks your sight to the east, and there is a door north.
